tenders.description_excerpt: Title: Research Project on Service Navigation Support for Seniors - 100032783 The Service Navigation Support for Seniors project will have two components. The first component, Component A will review the accessibility of information on support services available to seniors and/or their caregivers across all federal, provincial and territorial (FPT) jurisdictions and to identify common barriers. The objective of Component A is to understand what support services are the most frequently requested across the 14 FPT jurisdictions and why the access rate for information is more elevated, especially as it relates to barriers in accessing them. The second component, Component B, will use the results from Component A and identify, in collaboration with FPT Officials a number of case studies to analyse the mechanisms through which seniors and/or their caregivers learn about and/or access support services aiming to build awareness and improve access to service navigation supports. This would also include policy recommendations for jurisdictions to consider in enhancing service navigation support for seniors.

tenders.description_excerpt: Please return offers by email to solicitation-demandedesoumission@cnsc-ccsn.gc.ca Canada is seeking offers from qualified Offerors to provide professional services to review if and how thermal risk assessments (TRAs) are being conducted across the electrical power generation industry domestically and internationally, and if there are any existing regulatory frameworks addressing management of thermal effluent. The work will identify gaps in the standardized application of TRA methods and provide recommendations where applicable for improvement in standardization of TRAs for the nuclear power plants in Canada. The scope includes a critical evaluation of thermal effects literature for reliability and relevance for being able to inform a TRA, and the generation of an updated database of thermal effects thresholds for Canadian relevant species fish, and invertebrate species in the marine and freshwater environment. The scope of this project also includes reviewing and compiling data on regulatory approaches used by different facilities utilizing once-through cooling system technology (e.g., nuclear power plants, oil and gas plants, etc.), nationally and internationally, with respect to thermal risk assessment and the derivation and application of thermal thresholds.
